disclosure.title: Allow sending the first page?
disclosure.description: Page {{page}} will be sent to recognize text, translate it, and prepare a translated image.
disclosure.network: Internet is required. Processing does not happen entirely on this device.
disclosure.data: Image bytes, MIME type, dimensions, languages, and opaque attempt identifiers are sent. Filename, path, account, and dialogue are not sent.
disclosure.operator: Operated by {{operator}} ({{contact}}), using Google Cloud services.
disclosure.regions: The gateway and temporary data stay in {{gateway}}; OCR and translation may occur in {{processing}}.
disclosure.retention: The original and result are retained for up to {{originalMinutes}} and {{resultMinutes}} minutes; sanitized metadata for up to {{metadataDays}} days.
disclosure.cancellation: After processing starts, cancellation and deletion may not be immediate or possible.
